## Key Figures:

- **Weighted-Average Supply of Berths Marketed in North America (2005):** 190,000
  - Source: [RCL fiscal 2009 annual report (10-K), page 13](documents/report.md)
- **Weighted-Average Supply of Berths Marketed Globally (2005):** 288,000

  - Source: [RCL fiscal 2009 annual report (10-K), page 13](documents/report.md)
- **Weighted-Average Supply of Berths Marketed in North America (2006):** 201,000
  - Source: [RCL fiscal 2009 annual report (10-K), page 13](documents/report.md)

To find the percentage of the weighted-average supply of berths marketed globally in North America in 2005:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Weighted-Average Supply of Berths Marketed in North America (2005)}}{\text{Weighted-Average Supply of Berths Marketed Globally (2005)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{190,000}{288,000} \right) \times 100 \approx 65.97\% \]

- **Source:** [RCL fiscal 2009 annual report (10-K), page 13](documents/report.md)
